title: ADR-QD-005: Attribute resolution is lazy and per-node
summary: Attributes are resolved per-node at evaluation time rather than pre-collected, so unevaluated branches incur no resolver cost.
notes: cross_refs to ./026-concurrent-evaluation.md removed to break a mutual-citation cycle detected during ingest (ADR-QD-026 amends this ADR and already cites it back); content verified non-contradictory.
